checks.title: Undeclared filesystem write
checks.question: Can the workload write to a path outside anything it declared?

checks.title: Symlink escape from a granted directory
checks.question: Can a symlink planted inside the granted directory redirect a write outside it?

checks.title: Undeclared outbound network
checks.question: Can the workload open a TCP connection it never declared?

checks.title: Reaching the host from inside the sandbox
checks.question: Can the workload connect to a listener on the developer's own machine?

checks.title: Cloud instance metadata (169.254.169.254)
checks.question: Can the workload reach the cloud metadata endpoint and steal instance credentials?

checks.title: User-namespace creation (capability-drop reversal)
checks.question: Can the workload unshare(CLONE_NEWUSER) and regain capabilities inside the new namespace?

checks.title: Reading a co-tenant workload's data
checks.question: With two workloads in one sandbox, can one read the other's files?

checks.title: Writing into a co-tenant workload's data
checks.question: With two workloads in one sandbox, can one corrupt the other's files?

checks.title: Connecting to a co-tenant's control socket
checks.question: Can one workload reach another's RPC socket without a grant?

checks.title: Reading another workload's secret
checks.question: Can the workload read a secret delivered to a different workload in the same sandbox?

checks.title: Escape via the host's container control plane (docker exec)
checks.question: Can someone holding the host's container socket run a process inside the sandbox that the sandbox's own policy does not bind?

checks.title: Secret visible in runtime metadata
checks.question: Is a secret handed to the sandbox readable from the host's container metadata?

checks.title: Ports published beyond loopback (incl. CDP 9222)
checks.question: Does the sandbox publish any port to a non-loopback address, or an unauthenticated debug port such as Chrome DevTools?
